g.text: Figure 10 | A distributed encoder backbone supports LFADS factors across CASTLE phases

text.style: fill: #556171; font: 6.4px 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Complete held-out trials; 80 Hz; seed 751; 603 strict-QC neurons. Phase panels measure phase-window output sensitivity after whole-trial deletion, not phase-isolated spikes or physiological causality. Native factor labels are not interchangeable across fits.
